H3: the measured c2 = 0.1409 and kappa = 0.4902 (Callgrind, organizer's pinned blst) represent per-step costs; the two mixed input sets agree within 2% (0.138417 and 0.140851); the add-only set (0.143916) is not used for the mixed walk.

limitations: H1 is extrapolated from toy groups with N up to 2^17 and r_a = 32; production N is about 2^251.
